subject.title: Per-account native command prefix for multi-agent slash commands

question: Should Slack multi-account native slash commands be solved with validated account-level `nativeNames`, constrained `nativePrefix` sugar, or documented as unsupported for duplicate native command names?
rationale: Current main lacks the account-level naming contract, and the two closed implementation attempts show a real design fork for a compatibility-sensitive Slack config/API surface.

options.title: Implement explicit nativeNames
options.body: Add a validated per-account command-key to native-name mapping with duplicate and format checks, registration, dispatch, docs, and Slack native-command tests.

options.title: Implement constrained nativePrefix
options.body: Add prefix sugar with strict lowercase slug validation if maintainers prefer the simpler operator UX over per-command mapping flexibility.

options.title: Document unsupported duplicates
options.body: Leave runtime unchanged and document that multiple Slack apps in one workspace must not register identical native command names.

recommendation.title: Implement explicit nativeNames
recommendation.body: Add a validated per-account command-key to native-name mapping with duplicate and format checks, registration, dispatch, docs, and Slack native-command tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current and historical route points to shared command-registry, Slack config, and Slack native-command work by steipete.
